rules.colorUsage: KAAE brand guideline palette, light first. The default page is White (#FFFFFF) or Cream (#FFF2DB), as on the guideline's own pages. Indigo (#17087A) and Royal Indigo (#3833A3) are for header bands, plates, panels, tabs and scrims, and for titles and headings on a light page. Gold (#E8B85C) only for thin rules, frames, borders and small accents, or a title's accent line on indigo; never gold text on white or cream. Blue (#4770A3) for secondary lines, rules and icons; Bright Blue (#0F73DE) sparingly, one highlight at most. Body copy on a light page is Ink (#000000) or Indigo (#17087A); on indigo it is White (#FFFFFF) or Cream (#FFF2DB). Use an Indigo page only when the brief or the photo calls for it: an evening or dark invitation, a keynote or stage screen, a dark photo hero, or the requester asks for dark or navy. Never use colours outside this palette.
rules.logo: Use the supplied official logo unchanged, with its original aspect ratio. Minimum digital width 100px. Keep clear space around it equal to the height of its K.
rules.body: Left align digital body text. Use 1.4 line spacing, readable text and academic formality.
rules.restriction: Do not add reference-document factual copy, contact details, slogans, signatures or a seal to the invitation. Only the saved request supplies design copy.
rules.scriptFontNote: Provisional Sorani Kurdish typeface for drafts only: the brand guideline copy in this pack records no Kurdish typeface. The art director confirms the brand font before any release.
rules.rtl: Sorani Kurdish blocks are right-to-left: right-align them, keep them separate from Latin blocks, and give them about 20% more width and height than Latin text of the same size.
artDirection: Pick ONE hero photo that literally shows the subject. A second photo only as a texture blended into the text zone, never a grid cell. No multi-photo grids in social posts.
The hero fills 60-100% of the canvas and runs off at least two edges, or fills the top of a white or cream page. Keep a quiet region (sky, wall, blur) for the title.

Text always sits on something: the white or cream page, a cream card (22-25% of the height), an indigo plate, band or tab, or a fade to paper or to indigo over 35-50% of the height. Never bare text on a busy photo.
Elements bridge edges: a wordmark tab straddling the card's top edge, a call-to-action tab straddling a card, a portrait breaking over a panel.
People: cut out, placed bottom-left or left, bleeding off the edge, with the sunburst or grid motif behind. No circle masks.
A gold border frames series and carousels; a thin gold inset line frames single report posts. Never tilt or rotate photos.

Colour, as the brand guideline sets it: light first. A white or cream page; indigo for header bands, plates, tabs and scrims; gold only for thin rules, frames, the accent line on indigo and pills. Keep the photo's natural grade.

Type: bold geometric sans. On a light page an indigo main line, a royal-indigo accent line and dark small body text; on indigo a white main line and a gold line. Logo in a corner; the URL in a pill or the footer.
Bilingual: the same geometry in both languages. Sorani is right-aligned or centred in the same boxes; never mirror the photo.
With several photos, rank them by subject fit, sharpness and quiet space. Use the best as the hero, optionally one more as a faded texture, and drop the rest.

An indigo ground only when the brief or photo calls for it: an evening or dark invitation, a keynote or stage screen, a dark photo hero, or the requester asks for dark or navy. Otherwise white or cream.
